spans.s: दुंडुभ m. The same as डुंडुभ q.v.
दुंदम m. A kind of drum.
दुंदु m. 1. A kind of drum; 2. A name of Vasudeva, Kṛṣṇa’s father.
दुंदुभ m. A sort of large kettle drum.
दुंदुभि (I) m.f. A sort of large kettle-drum, दुंदुभिस्ताडितोऽयम् Ve.i., R.ix.11.
दुंदुभि (II) m. 1. An epithet of Varuṇa; 2. of Kṛṣṇa.
दून a. (f. ना) Pained, afflicted, distressed, fatigued, कथमथ वंचयसे जनमनुगतमसमशरज्वरदूनम् Git.G.viii.
